summary: RFC-0062 OQ-4: one audit-entry schema, RFC 8785 canonical bytes in all three SDKs, one genesis and timestamp rule, a cross-SDK conformance fixture every SDK verifies; its own Phase 1 task, blocks nothing

options.description: Shared schema, JCS, cross-SDK fixture, in Phase 1 as a parallel task
Schema and fixture, each SDK verifies only its own output
Document per-SDK verification; remove the dangling link

body: Full rubric in RFC-0062 OQ-4 resolution (2026-11-06). Three divergent chain encodings (TypeScript, Go, Python); no SDK verifies another; the website claims verifiable; spec/adapters.md links to a schema that does not exist. Every transparency system fixes bytes before hashing (DSSE PAE, RFC 6962, Rekor, JCS in OpenID Federation). Old chains carry schemaVersion.
